text:
maria-cs: FYI Stitch onboarding hit intermittent 429s during mobile SDK init. Customer reports spikes during CI warmup and first user sessions. They’re blocked for tomorrow’s SSO cutover, asking for quick mitigation. Logs show a bunch of `preflight` requests followed by 429s.
maria-cs: Snippet from their mobile logs: 
```
POST https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/init
Headers: {
  Authorization: Bearer <ephemeral>,
  X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-1,
  Host: api.redwood.example.com
}
Response: 429 Too Many Requests (rate_limit)
```
mateo-cs: They’re on mobile-sdk v0.9.1 (RN). Also seeing occasional 401s when the ephemeral token rotate happens in parallel. Customer says they warm 15 containers concurrently during deploy.
sam-eng: Quick hypothesis: region header says eu-west-1 but DNS/edge resolved them into our us-west pool (GCLOUD/CF worker routing). That mismatch can send traffic to the wrong capacity bucket and trigger tenant-level rate caps. Can you confirm the resolved IPs?
maria-cs: I asked for traceroute; they pasted IPs: `34.83.12.45, 34.86.7.191, 35.204.4.10`.
infra-bot: alert: observed spike for tenant `t-9f8e7d` at 2026-03-22T14:03:10Z — concurrent preflight fanout = 18, token rotates in 5s window.
dev-rel: Two quick mitigations we can recommend to Stitch immediately: 1) set `REDWOOD_REGION` explicitly at SDK init, 2) stagger token refreshes/limit preflight concurrency to <=5 during warmups.
onboard-engineer: To add: mobile snippet to pin region and reduce fanout: 
```js
Redwood.init({
  apiKey: '__ephemeral__',
  region: 'eu-west-1',
  retry: { maxRetries: 3, baseDelayMs: 150 },
  preflight: { maxConcurrency: 4 }
});
```
sam-eng: For service-side short-term fix we can: 1) accept `X-Redwood-Region` as authoritative fallback, 2) temporarily raise their tenant rate cap for 24h, or 3) route their IPs to eu-west pool. Need ops sign-off + tenant ID and IPs.
mateo-cs: Tenant ID = `t-9f8e7d`. IPs sent above. Customer is OK with temporary quota bump.
onboard-engineer: Ops requires the list in a ticket. I'll file and tag infra.
maria-cs: I’ll send the code snippet + ask them to set `REDWOOD_REGION` and apply jitter to token refresh. Also asked them to lower concurrent warmups from 15 -> 4-6.
infra-bot: ticket created: #INC-9482 — routing exception requested for t-9f8e7d to eu-west pool for 24h.
sam-eng: If ops can’t route immediately, we should enable per-tenant grace windows in rate limiter for preflight endpoints (low risk). I’ll put a small change on canary to accept region header fallback for preflight only.
dev-rel: Also let them know to upgrade to SDK v0.9.3 (includes jittered token refresh). Quick changelog: v0.9.3 fixes concurrent refresh race and default `preflight.maxConcurrency`=3.
maria-cs: Customer agreed to apply our SDK patch and drop warmup concurrency. They want us to confirm the temporary quota bump first.
onboard-engineer: Ops confirmed: quota bump applied for `t-9f8e7d` until 2026-03-23T16:00:00Z. Please monitor.
maria-cs: Thanks — I’ll follow up after their SSO cutover tomorrow morning.
mateo-cs: +1 monitoring. keep me posted.
sam-eng: follow-up action: create small doc snippet in onboarding guide about region pinning + token jitter. I’ll draft.
maria-cs: Great — thanks all :thumbsup:
